name: Artificer Core Animations
description: The crafting-bench effects a Process item can choose from. Each entry is an INDEX of CSS that must already exist: an id here means a stylesheet somewhere provides `.artificer-anim-<id>`, reading `--process-level` (0-1) and `--process-color`. Names describe the motion, not the process, so a ferment can pulse and a sieve can shake.

animations.label: None
animations.description: No motion. For processes that should look inert while running.

animations.label: Pulse
animations.description: A slow swell and settle, brightening with intensity. Suits heat, ferment, infusion — anything that builds.

animations.label: Shake
animations.description: A fast rotate and press with a drifting particle field. Suits grind, sift, mill — anything abrasive or agitated.
